title: Central simple algebras and continuous Galois degree-two classes
statement: For every field K, its set of Brauer equivalence classes of finite-dimensional central simple K-algebras is in bijection with H²_G(Ks^×) [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology].

source.place: Theorem 03R7, its scalar-defect construction following Lemma 03R6, and Section 0DVG

proof.text: Apply the proved upstream Algebra.IsCentral.exists_algEquiv_matrix_of_isSepClosed (recorded among lem-sc-c1-brauer-trivial declarations) to obtain a positive matrix splitting. Apply the matrix-lift theorem to obtain locally constant lifts and a homogeneous cycle. Its homology image x, with these concrete witnesses, satisfies HasBrauerScalarDefect. Faithfulness with A=B proves uniqueness of x. Choose that unique class for each A.

Faithfulness in the reverse direction proves that the unique-class map respects IsBrauerEquivalent. Quotient.lift descends it to BrauerGroup. For injectivity, induct on both quotient representatives and apply the forward direction of faithfulness, followed by Quotient.sound.

For each x, the crossed-product realization theorem supplies A realizing x. Faithfulness with A=A identifies the chosen class of A with x. The quotient class of A is therefore a preimage. Equiv.ofBijective gives the required equivalence. The choice of the class uses its proved uniqueness, not mere existence of an arbitrary witness.

proof_origin.place: The scalar-defect construction following Lemma 03R6, Theorem 03R7, and Section 0DVG
